title: Using ARP to Implement Transparent Subnet Gateways
publisher_or_issuer: Network Working Group / RFC archival corpus

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 1027 documents Proxy ARP as a widely used technique in which a gateway answers ARP requests on behalf of hosts on other physical networks.
claims_extracted.notes: The RFC explicitly frames the technique as a migration aid when many hosts lack subnet support.

notes: Strong primary evidence for Proxy ARP behavior and its installed-base motivation.
